searchRules.answer: Mirage is a virtual terminal that gives AI agents one bash-compatible shell over every data source.

hits.title: Mirage: a virtual terminal for AI agents
hits.content: Mirage is a bash-compatible shell over one virtual filesystem. It mounts object stores, SaaS apps and databases at a prefix, so an agent reads them with cat, grep and find.
hits.rawContent:
# Mirage

hits.title: Getting started
hits.content: Install the package, create a workspace, and mount a bucket at /data. Every command runs through one dispatcher.

Why agents	prefer a shell:

  one interface,   every backend.

hits.title: Mounts and prefixes
hits.content: A mount binds one backend to a prefix. A listing costs one request.
